custom_fields.label: Weaving Receipt
custom_fields.description: Internal reference - set automatically when this Stock Entry is the Manufacture entry raised from a Weaving Receipt's submit.

custom_fields.label: Dyeing Receipt
custom_fields.description: Internal reference - set automatically when this Stock Entry is the Repack entry raised from a Dyeing Receipt's submit.

custom_fields.label: Dyeing Contract
custom_fields.description: Internal reference - set automatically on the Material Transfer entry raised by Dyeing Contract's Issue Fabric button, and on the Repack entry raised from a Dyeing Receipt (best-effort - first Dyeing Contract found across that receipt's rows).

custom_fields.label: Sales Order
custom_fields.description: Internal reference - set automatically on the Material Transfer entry raised by Dyeing Contract's Issue Fabric button, when that Dyeing Contract itself carries a Sales Order reference.
